payload.source_text: is used when it is burrowed. Sand Pillar damages any player standing on top of the sand trap.
is used when it is burrowed. Tunnel Worm explodes out of the ground and heavily damages anyone near it.
is used by the Worm when it is burrowed. It appears as a whirlwind on the ground, does small amount of damage and pulls all party members towards its center.
Amon's Curtain Call is survived by hiding behind frozen players; without an ice block providing line-of-sight protection, the attack kills players.
an AoE centred around the boss that does no damage, but inflicts Paralysis if hit.
If the abyss worm is not distracted with Crystallized Rock when it searches for fodder, it casts Bottomless Desert, pulling the party to the middle and dealing heavy damage.
Leaves Damage over time areas, and eventually a ring all around the room. These areas will fade after she casts either Morbid Advance or Morbid Retreat

and Morbid Retreat force your character to move forward, or backwards respectively. When Lorelei says "Ramble...Ramble..." that indicates forward, and when she says "Down...Down..." that indicates backwards. Position yourself accordingly so that you avoid Virgin Tears as much as possible. Note that "forward" and "backward" are relative to the direction you're facing; it does not mean you'll be drawn to/repelled from the boss. Pick the safest route you can based on the skill to follow.
ground.
Players looking at Angra Mainyu when Mortal Gaze resolves receive Doom; turning away avoids it, and lit platforms can remove Doom.
Double Sever produces paired conal attacks: first in front and behind Phantom Ray, then on its sides.
Players must place comets outside Behemoth's targeting ring and hide behind a surviving comet to block line of sight from Ecliptic Meteor.
Liavinne summons zombies that chase a non-tank player; the player with the red/orange arrow should bring the marked AoE into the horde so Liavinne's attack destroys them.
Poqhiraj becomes untargetable and lands at one end of the corridor with a proximity attack.
Mumuepo chains players before casting Thal's Fury; unchained players must use Thal's Scepter to free them before the cast finishes.
Giruveganaus lowers its shoulder before charging forward and damaging players in its path.
Sacred Totem marks cause totems to drop; before Totem Chant finishes, totems must be carried out of the purple circle or they animate and make Canu Vanu immune.
The encounter is a sequence of Sanguine Sirens waves; players dodge line AoEs from the mobs and circular AoEs from offshore cannons.
Narrow AoE markers appear at the arena edge, followed by a large AoE attack in the spaces between them; the encounter is primarily a positioning check.
Linear high-damage attack.
Targeted high-damage explosion on marked players.
Miniaturized players use the purple puddle to be Devoured by Cerberus, enter its stomach, and destroy the internal adds so the raid can weaken and re-chain the boss.
Void Summon lights floor platforms that require the indicated number of players; failing a platform summons a voidsent add.
Byblos becomes invulnerable and summons adds; after the adds die, a tethered orb must be guided into Byblos to remove the invulnerability.
Area of Effect attack centred around Cladoselache. Players hit will take moderate damage, be stun Stunned for a couple seconds, and inflicted with a stack of vulnerability up Vulnerability Up.

A circular attack focused on one player. This will create a persisting circular damaging area upon impact and should be placed accordingly. Stepping into it will inflict vulnerability up Vulnerability Up.
A large cone shaped Area of Effect attack. Getting hit by this will knock back.
The boss's room-wide attack opens floor fissures that leak aether; a Corrupted Gel must be pulled onto each plume and killed there to plug it.
After the add phase Waukkeon casts Turbine, a party-wide AoE with knockback; players stack near the boss with safe platform space behind them.
When Queen Hawk uses Ally, bees gather in two groups along the arena edge and fire large untelegraphed column attacks; later Knight Hawk adds tether to the boss.
During Payday, players collect piles of gold before Daigoro reaches them; each pile collected by Daigoro fills the duty gauge and increases the resulting group-wide damage.
Corruptions tether marked players with Prey and cast Aetheric Mimicry; the marked player passes the effect to a passive mob before the cast completes.
After stack markers create null-gravity zones, Xande casts Ancient Quaga; players avoid the heavy raid damage by standing in a null-gravity zone and floating.
Crawling zombies must be killed before reaching the center; each one that reaches it strengthens Avere Bravearm's Red Wedding attack.
During Ferdiad's expanding circular AoE, tethered Wicked Jester adds must be killed so the circle stops growing before it consumes the arena.
After Bone Dragon dies, Platinal skeletons revive and run toward it; each skeleton that reaches the dragon deals unblockable raid damage.
1000 Tonze Swing covers the arena and is intended to be negated with the Manawall buff obtained from the mammet/lever mechanic.

Daidarabotchi will raise one of its arms and slam it down on the ground. Getting hit by this will result in medium damage and one (1) debuff stack of Vulnerability Up. It is suggested to stand on its other side.
AoE that will follow the marked player.

Daidarabotchi will hit the ground with its fist and create a circular, persistent AoE (a shimmering lake) around the centre of the area. That lake will grow over time and will cover ca. 75% of the area but will disappear again after some time.
Demonic Eye is countered by activating a Shadowy Orb to gain Gloam before the cast resolves.
Glasya Labolas uses Vile Utterance, a conal AoE.
Nameless Spirits travel from portals toward Paiyo Reiyo; players must intercept them so they detonate before reaching the NPC.
Manor Butler add spawns during the Manor Jester encounter; players should kill the adds while avoiding the boss's ice patches.
Moderate damage on the entire party. Prometheus always casts this ability first, surrounding the arena in fire.
90 degree Cone directly in front of the boss.
270 degree Cone directly behind the boss, hitting everywhere Needle Gun doesn't.
Four proximity AoEs that hit at each cardinal direction.
When Phlegethon moves to the center and casts Ancient Flare, each alliance must stand on its assigned platform to raise the barrier or the raid wipes.
Gogmagolem periodically uses Plaincracker, a high-damage cone directed at the tank.
Hyperdimensional Slash places a red directional AoE toward a random player and leaves an Aetherial Tear where it reaches the wall.
- deals some damage in a targeted circle area.
- Stuns enemies in a targeted circle area. Has a 30 second cooldown.
Darkfire progressively covers the bridge with fire; each use also causes a Flambeau to spawn, which must be killed before it reaches the burning ground or self-destructs.
A red-marked player must hide behind one of the room's statues so the statue absorbs Anchag's lethal tether damage.
When Cloud of Darkness moves around the ring she fires Zero-form Particle Beam through the center; players must move to the sides because it has no ground telegraph.
111-tonze Swing is an untelegraphed 360-degree melee cleave with knockback and very heavy damage.
Dojun-maru uses Tatami-gaeshi; the encounter also requires avoiding long column AoEs and quickly killing clones.
Leaps to one side of the room and cleaves the room in front of him for high damage.

Multiple swords rain down around the arena, damaging to nearby players. After finishing the cast, the boss does a room-wide AoE, and the swords become targetable. Those will channel Corruption. Unkilled swords eventually explode, but these explosions can be avoided. Players should focus on the massive sword in the middle, which does a high-damage room -wide explosion if it is not destroyed.
Marks a player and pushes them back after the cast.
Slithy Zolool Ja summons colored totems with varying buffs and debuffs; unclaimed totems can be recalled by the boss, granting their effects to him.
Tyrant spawns Sailor adds; the tank should face Tyrant away from the group and pick up the adds.
A long-cast attack that will attack everyone outside of Rangda's melee range. (Similar to Dragon's Voice from Cutter's Cry).
Progenitrix summons Grey and Lava bombs around the arena; Grey bombs should be destroyed immediately.
Coeurl Sruti uses Radial Blaster, an AoE around itself that applies stacks of Magical Damage Received Up when hit.
After charging and knocking back a player, Captain Madison marks a random player and continuously shoots them until enough damage is dealt to him.
is a large PBAoE spell. This spell can be avoided by stunning Lady Amandine.
At roughly 75% HP, a Tempest Biast add spawns; the tank should pick it up.
Rose Garden performs a rotating breath attack while untargetable adds use smaller breath attacks; later casts also summon Rose Hips that must be killed before they explode.
(Steward) is a large PBAoE spell. This spell can be avoided by stunning Steward.
